candidates.description: Place: Guilin, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Chinese name: 比亚迪F6 (bǐyǎdí F6) Year of launch: 2010 BYD Auto is a subsidiary of BYD Company, a major manufacturer of rechargeable batteries. One year later it launched the e6, an electric vehicle, which is also operating as a taxi in cities of countries including Belgium, Colombia, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the USA. BYD is currently naming their cars after the Chinese dynasties, with names including Qin, Tang, Song, Yuan and Shang. BYD first showcased a BYD F6 prototype in 2006, but the production version, which had its debut in 2007, looked nothing like it. candidates.description: Place: Huangyao, Zhaoping County, Hezhou, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Chinese name: 比亚迪速锐 (bǐyǎdí sùruì) Year of launch: 2012 BYD Auto is a subsidiary of BYD Company, a major manufacturer of rechargeable batteries. BYD started producing cars in 2005 when it acquired Qinchuan, a company that produced the Flyer small car. In 2005 it was followed by the hugely popular F3, a copy of the Toyota Corolla E120. It was the best selling car in China in 2009. BYD is infamous for copying cars of Japanese car manufacturers: through the years it has made copies of the Toyota Aygo, Corolla E120, E140, Estima, Honda Accord, Honda Odyssey and Renault Mégane Coupé-Cabriolet, while other cars have striking similarities with the Buick Excelle HRV, Mercedes-Benz SL and Lexus RX. Two years after the arrival of the F3 sedan the hatchback version, named F3R, was launched, which means it is a mechanical copy of the Toyota Corolla as well, albeit now with a rear end inspired by the Buick HRV (Daewoo/Chevrolet Lacetti). As a battery producer, BYD is one of the largest makers of electric cars and plug-in hybrids in the world. The F3DM was the world's first mass-produced plug-in hybrid. One year later it launched the e6, an electric vehicle, which is also operating as a taxi in cities of countries including Belgium, Colombia, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the USA. BYD is currently naming their cars after the Chinese dynasties, with names including Qin, Tang, Song, Yuan and Shang. The BYD Surui, a copy of the Toyota Corolla E140, was launched in 2012. The BYD Qin plug-in hybrid and electriv vehicle (EV300), as well as the electric BYD e5 are based on the Surui. This is the facelifted version (2015+).

candidates.title: File:Berlin, Flughafen Tempelhof, Berlin E-Prix 2019, Greentech Festival, Mercedes-Benz EQC -- 2019 -- 5536.jpg
candidates.author: Dietmar Rabich
candidates.description: The Mercedes-Benz EQC emblem at the Greentech Festival ( Berlin E-Prix 2019) on the grounds of Tempelhof Airport, Berlin , Germany Berlin-Tempelhof Airport is considered one of the most important airports in aviation history. Its origins date back to the early 20th century: the first flight demonstrations took place on Tempelhofer Feld in 1909, and Tempelhof was officially opened as an airport in 1923, quickly developing into a central air traffic hub for the Weimar Republic. Between 1936 and 1941, the monumental new airport building was constructed under the Nazi regime according to plans by Ernst Sagebiel. The semicircular building with its huge roof structure was considered one of the largest buildings in the world at the time and was intended to reflect the regime’s power. Tempelhof gained international fame during the Berlin Airlift in 1948/49. After the Soviet Union blocked West Berlin, Western allies supplied the city from the air for months. Thousands of planes landed at Tempelhof every day – a symbol of freedom and perseverance during the Cold War. In the post-war period, Tempelhof remained important primarily for domestic German and Allied air traffic. However, it lost its significance with the expansion of larger airports such as Tegel. Flight operations were discontinued in 2008. After that, Tempelhof Field became a public park. The listed building stands as a testament to architecture, aviation history, and the dramatic events of the 20th century.

candidates.title: File:Fillière°Thorens-Glières - 74570 - 2023.02.06 - Sibra Glières - Philibert - Iveco Crossway n°1245 & Volkswagen Caravelle n°313 © Anthony Levrot.jpg
candidates.author: Anthony Levrot
candidates.description: Un Iveco Crossway (n°1245 de Philibert Transport) et une Volkswagen Caravelle (n°313 de Philibert Transport) stationnés sur le parking cars du Plateau des Glières, situé sur la Route des Glières (Fillière, commune déléguée de Thorens-Glières) le 6 février 2023. Ces véhicules, mis en service respectivement en septembre 2014 et février 2017, arborent la découpe des lignes saisonnières hivernales du réseau Sibra, organisé par la communauté d’agglomération du Grand Annecy. Le premier assure la ligne G, reliant la gare routière (Annecy) au plateau des Glières (Fillière), tandis que le second est affecté à la ligne G2, reliant le chef-lieu (Évires) au plateau des Glières (Fillière).
